evidence: Wikipedia's article on Beyoncé: Whitney Houston inspired her to pursue performing, and made her believe she could do it.

earlier.title: I Wanna Dance with Somebody (Who Loves Me)

trackPair.whatToListenFor: Listen for the voice used as the main instrument: long runs, held notes, a gospel-trained singer stepping out in front of a pop track. Houston did it alone; Beyoncé did it first at the front of a group.

explanation: Beyoncé has said that Whitney Houston was the singer who made her believe she could become a performer. It is a documented line in pop between two gospel-trained singers from Black church traditions who became the biggest pop voices of their decades.
